statement: Every geometrically connected finite etale cover of the punctured Gaussian elliptic curve whose geometric Galois closure is nilpotent has only cuspidal arithmetically normalized procyclic subgroups at every coefficient prime. More generally, at a fixed ell it suffices to factor the actual cover through an ell-group Galois-closure cover of an intermediate cover with prime-to-ell Galois closure.
